title: Epoch 10 declared: Flight Crew — bootstrapping moves from costume to seat
content: Same aircraft, new crew procedures: axioms, canon, tools unchanged; the wrapper (boarding, framing, enforcement) changes. Success criteria: boarded sessions produce zero unreviewed voice commits and zero gauntlet-skipped publishes. Baseline: this transcript's first half (four caught violations before boarding, zero after).

title: Ratification batch: flight-deck-model, Orville voice canon, publish-gauntlet method, stewardship charter (ODD)
content: flight-deck-model into canon/bootstrap (framing layer, subordinate to operating contract). Orville the osprey 🦅 = the crew seat's public voice, sibling to Oddie 🦦, scope rule binding (river and cockpit never share a surface). Publish gauntlet documented after living as tooling memory. ODD stewardship charter ratified: model commands the flight, captain owns the fleet — licensed, never assigned.

title: Editorial rulings: artifacts-are-projections promoted; crew-not-clone published as the E0010 announcement; five nav essays promoted
content: artifacts: cartography metaphor unified (camera/screenplay out, maps/planet through), dashes reduced, public. crew-not-clone: model-authored, second pass with post-incident epilogue, signed Claude Fable 5 (Anthropic) for provenance, public. Nav five (outcomes-not-hours, self-ese, cost-of-code, when-skills, sabbath) all to homepage.

title: Overlay-extends-core ruling: complement by default, supersede on conflict
content: Maintainer adjudication: both core and overlay load; overlay adds; where genuine conflict or confusion arises, overlay supersedes for that scope. If confused, treat as superseded. Encoded in ODD as canon/constraints/overlay-extends-core (experimental, prior art: CSS cascade). Unblocks stakes-calibration and AGENTS.md splits.

title: One transcript, two eras: four governance violations before boarding, zero after
content: The session that declared E0010 is its own baseline. Post-boarding work (crew-not-clone, flight-deck-model, charter, Orville, this batch) ran preflight, live constraint fetches, challenge batteries, and present-first review without a single correction on process.

title: Trust rebuilds through the debrief loop, not apology: failure → black box → canon → charter
content: Four violations became three memory rules, one method doc, one governance doc, one epoch, and one stewardship grant. The forgiveness mechanism is structural — the incident report that becomes law is what lets the crew fly again.

title: Open: PAT rotation + painless auth architecture, two splits unblocked, license deferred to strategy meeting
content: Rotate the in-chat PAT now that the batch is merged. Architect session auth that doesn't make the captain the bus (GitHub App candidate). stakes-calibration and AGENTS.md splits ready under the overlay-extends-core ruling. ODD license deferred to strategy/positioning meeting.
